token.title: Personal Access Token
token.description: GitHub Fine-Grained Personal Access Token (github_pat_...) or Classic PAT (ghp_...).

defaultOwner.title: Default Organization / Owner
defaultOwner.description: Optional default GitHub organization or user login (e.g., 'MemberJunction') used when a repository owner is not explicitly provided.

allowedRepositories.title: Allowed Repositories
allowedRepositories.description: Optional comma-separated list of allowed 'owner/repo' or 'owner/*' patterns (e.g., 'MemberJunction/*,BlueCypress/Skip-Client-Open-App').

allowMerge.title: Allow Pull Request Merge
allowMerge.description: Whether this credential is permitted to merge pull requests. Defaults to false.

defaultPRMode.title: Default Pull Request Mode
defaultPRMode.description: Whether pull requests created using this credential default to 'draft' or 'ready' for review.

apiBaseUrl.title: GitHub API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: GitHub REST API base URL. Defaults to 'https://api.github.com' (use 'https://<hostname>/api/v3' for GitHub Enterprise Server).
